derived_comparison.B100: Current415mm minimum is5mm shorter than nominal420mm retracted length. It is not a direct replacement.
derived_comparison.B100_possible_redesign: Moving the fixed eye30mm farther from the moving eye restores25..175mm extension. This is an untested mounting proposal, not approved CAD.
derived_comparison.load_screen: The previous1500kg/friction/3g calculation is illustrative, not established steering demand. B068 is only1.018 times that6677.9N screen; no design margin or qualification follows.

control_and_safety.48V_options: CNO/COO support36..64V; exact control configuration must be selected.
control_and_safety.feedback: 0.1mm CAN resolution is not mechanical position accuracy; internal deadband, tolerances and play remain.
control_and_safety.protections: Overload, temperature and voltage monitoring protect the actuator; system-level steering fault handling remains separate.
control_and_safety.manual_override: A6mm socket input is documented. Access, loaded behavior and a safe vehicle-service procedure are unverified.
control_and_safety.application_approval: No steering-specific approval found for the HD candidates. Industrial/utility-vehicle marketing is not such approval.

larger_linear_alternative.web_duty_conflict: Some manufacturer regional pages state45%; confirm current configured product. Up to100% is load-dependent, not full-load universal.
larger_linear_alternative.packaging: Larger body and mounting interfaces; not evaluated as a replacement for the HD clevises/rack.

steering_specific_lead.source_supported: Manufacturer explicitly describes steer-by-wire AGV/lift-truck applications with24/36/48V variants.
steering_specific_lead.integration_gap: Rotary geared steering output requires a new pinion/rack or other transmission and exact vendor mounting/output drawings. No ratio or shaft geometry has been invented.
steering_specific_lead.rating_gate: Published peak5second, S2two-minute and S2sixty-minute torque columns are different ratings; none is a general continuous steering approval.
steering_specific_lead.recommendation: Keep as a steering-oriented architecture lead, not a selected drop-in unit.
